money_cells_2026_08_14_ap_bill_overclaim.note: ap_bill blanket-required on all 15 maintenance leaves; verified live per leaf. Only 2 own it for real (KEPT, real Built added): wo.create_bill and maintenance.modal.create_bill are the SAME CreateBillModal.tsx (mounted from MaintenanceHome.tsx and WorkOrderDetailPage.tsx) — a genuine createVendorBill call that persists a hard accounting.bills.work_order_id FK and reuses the canonical VendorBillForm. The other 13 own no accounting.bills data anywhere: wo.create (CreateWorkOrderModal.tsx / WorkOrderCreateModal.tsx / CreateWOSection*.tsx) never calls createVendorBill — WO creation and bill creation are separate actions. wo.source.is/es/ac/et/rt/it/rs are WO-list source-type filter tabs (WorkOrdersTable.tsx) showing resolved_vendor_name but zero bill_id/EntityLink kind="bill" per row. road_service.active (RoadServiceActivePanel.tsx) has zero bill references. parts_inventory.record_purchase (PartsInventoryTable.tsx 'Record Purchase' modal) captures a real vendor_id but last_purchase_invoice_number is a plain string, not a bill FK. warranty.create_claim (WarrantyClaimsPage.tsx), maintenance.modal.fault_rule (FaultRuleModal.tsx, a rule-config modal for auto-WO generation), and maintenance.modal.create_expense (CreateExpenseModal.tsx, a separate money instrument from bills) all have zero bill references.

picker_law_master_data_create_exemption_.note: master.drivers.create and master.vehicles.create audited via direct component read (DriversMasterDataPage.tsx / VehiclesMasterDataPage.tsx, createMaintenanceDriver / the vehicle-master equivalent). These create a NEW row in the maintenance-specific 'master data' reference tables (first_name/last_name/cdl_number/... for drivers; the vehicle equivalent) — a separate, narrower reference list from the real driver/unit roster, not an edit-or-link-to-an-existing-entity surface, so no EntityPicker/ReferenceSelect/Combobox is expected by design. Same class as this module's own already-documented parts.vendor_default exemption. Currently credited only by the broad module-loop sweep; this note documents why that is an acceptable non-gap, not a guessed removal of picker_law.

picker_law_record_purchase_part_descript.note: parts_inventory.record_purchase audited via direct component read (PartsInventoryTable.tsx 'Record Purchase' modal). The modal's Vendor field is a real EntityPicker(kind="vendor", allowCreate, allowClear) — confirmed picker_law-compliant. Its 'Part description' field is deliberately free text, not an EntityPicker/catalog FK to maintenance.maintenance_parts: the page's own emptyText documents the design intent ('No parts on hand. Click + Record Purchase to track daily purchases. Anti-theft pattern: minimal stock kept on hand.') — this is a lightweight running purchase log, not a structured parts-catalog binding, so a free-text description is correct, not a missing picker. Same non-gap class as this module's parts.vendor_default and master-data-create exemptions above. wo.create_bill / wo.create_expense (same maintenance module, Work order + Unit fields) were also live-verified this session: Work order is a search-existing-only linkage field (no inline-create expected — a WO must be created via its own multi-field flow, not quick-created from a downstream Bill/Expense form) and Unit correctly shows '+ Add new unit' first row with correct Escape-to-restore behavior in both modals. pm.schedule.create and inspections.create Unit pickers were also live-verified this session, same '+ Add new unit' + clean-Escape result. wo.create and all 7 wo.source.* leaves share one CreateWorkOrderModal.tsx code path whose Vendor field is EntityPicker(kind="vendor", allowCreate) — confirmed via fresh source re-read this session (not just the prior session's live click).
